name: HRT_SKILLS_CRITERIA_DN
description: This is a denormalized table.It stores all the information related to core and role skills assigned to a person.

columns.name: SKILL_CRITERIA_DN_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of the table. System generated.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: SKILL_CRITERIA_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the skill criteria type as lookup code. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_HRT_SKILL_CRITERIA_TYPES

columns.name: CONTENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HRT_CONTENT_ITEMS_B table

columns.name: SKILL
columns.description: Name of the assigned role/core skill.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: PERSON_ID of the assigned skill.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: ASSIGNMENT_ID of the skill assignee.

columns.name: PROFILE_ID
columns.description: PROFILE_ID of the assigned skill.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which skill is assigned.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_BY
columns.description: ID of the person who assigned the skill.

columns.name: DEVELOPED_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether assigned skill is developed by person or not.

columns.name: ACHIEVED_FLAG
columns.description: To identified  whether assigned skill is achieved by person or not .

columns.name: CONFIRMED_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether assigned skill is confirmed or not .

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: Holds JobID that is foreign key to PER_JOBS_F

columns.name: JOB_CODE
columns.description: JOB_CODE for ROLE type assigned skill.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: This column denotes name for the Job.

columns.name: REQUIRED_LEVEL
columns.description: The required level set by assignor.

columns.name: ACHIEVED_LEVEL
columns.description: Level that person has achieved for assigned skill.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_NAME
columns.description: Assignment Name of the skill assignee person.

columns.name: ENDORSEMENT_COUNT
columns.description: Total count of the endorsement that person has for assigned skil.

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_GLOBAL_LEG_CODE
columns.description: Country context for the Global Name.

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_GLOBAL_CHARSET_CTX
columns.description: Specifies the character set in which the details are stored.

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_GLOBAL_DISP_NAME
columns.description: Skill assignee Person's Display Name

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_GLOBAL_FULL_NAME
columns.description: Skill assignee Person's Full Name

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_GLOBAL_LIST_NAME
columns.description: Skill assignee Person's List Name

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_LOCAL_LEG_CODE
columns.description: Country context for the Local Name.

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_LOCAL_CHARSET_CTX
columns.description: Specifies the character set in which the details are stored for local name.

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_LOCAL_DISP_NAME
columns.description: Skill assignee Person's Local Display Name

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_LOCAL_FULL_NAME
columns.description: Skill assignee Person's Local Full Name

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_LOCAL_LIST_NAME
columns.description: Skill assignee Person's Local List Name

columns.name: ASG_BY_GLOBAL_NAME_LEG_CODE
columns.description: Country context for the Assigned By Global Name.

columns.name: ASG_BY_GLOBAL_NAME_CHARSET_CTX
columns.description: Specifies the character set in which the details are stored for Assigned By global name.

columns.name: ASG_BY_GLOBAL_DISP_NAME
columns.description: Assigned By Person's Global Display Name

columns.name: ASG_BY_LOCAL_NAME_LEG_CODE
columns.description: Country context for the Assigned By Local Name.

columns.name: ASG_BY_LOCAL_NAME_CHARSET_CTX
columns.description: Specifies the character set in which the details are stored for Assigned By local name.

columns.name: ASG_BY_LOCAL_DISP_NAME
columns.description: Assigned By Person's Local Display Name

columns.name: POSITION_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
